title: Hearty Charred Moroccan Potato Amlou
description: A charred, crunchy, festive Moroccan dish featuring russet potato, namul-blanch-season, jain-friendly, formed into amlou.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the potato cubes with olive oil, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the potato mixture on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
While the potatoes are roasting, toast the chopped almonds in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until they are lightly browned.
In a large skillet, heat a couple of tablespoons of olive oil over medium-high heat, then add the roasted potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are charred and crispy.
Stir in the chopped parsley, toasted almonds, honey, and lemon juice, and cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the potatoes are well coated.
Transfer the potato mixture to a serving platter and shape into amlou, or a decorative mound.
Serve the Hearty Charred Moroccan Potato Amlou hot, garnished with additional parsley and almonds if desired.
